provenance: sourced by the coordinating agent (message of 2026-10-18); VC = vendor-claimed, IM = independently measured, VC-PR = vendor-claimed in a peer-reviewed paper, ASSUMED = not in the source, chosen here and stated
conversions: two_qubit_error_kind 'average' = RB / vendor gate error r (engine plays a Pauli error p = 1.25 r); 'process' = EPLG, a process infidelity per layered gate (r = 0.8 EPLG, p = EPLG). one_qubit_error = average infidelity per sx pulse (the ISA plays a generic rotation as two sx: an upper bound for a native-rotation device). memory_error_per_layer = pure dephasing of an idle qubit per depth-1 layer of duration t_2q (T2 = -t_2q / ln(1 - 2 p_mem), T1 = 1e6 s).
